forum.read_time: {count, plural, one {# min read} other {# min read}}

admin.accent_help: The color of section labels, the active section, the numbers in Most discussed and links in an article. Leave it empty for the ink red.
admin.dateline_help: Today's date in the header, and "Night edition" when a reader uses dark mode.
admin.fonts_help: Newsreader and IBM Plex Sans Condensed, served from your forum. Turn this off to use fonts every computer already has.
admin.lead_help: Which discussion leads the front page. If none qualifies, the newest discussion leads.
admin.lead_liked: The most-liked discussion from the last 30 days
admin.lead_liked_off: The most-liked discussion (turn on Likes to use this)
admin.lead_sticky_off: The newest sticky discussion (turn on Sticky to use this)
admin.nameplate_help: The paper's name, set large across the top of the discussion list. Leave it empty to use the forum title.
admin.sections_help: The tags shown as sections in the nav, up to 12. Pick none to show your primary tags.
admin.sections_no_tags: Turn on Tags to build the section nav from your tags.
admin.tagline_help: The line under the nameplate. Leave it empty to use the forum description.
